items.title: How we used AI (draft, Rhea to edit)
items.text:
Granola recorded and summarized some sessions; we said so on the first night and anyone could opt out.

Claude (Anthropic’s AI assistant) read the sticky notes and handwriting from photos, drafted labels and summaries, pulled candidate quotes, and wrote the code for the site and this zine’s editor.

Every note, poem, page and photo was made by a person. The story is Rhea’s as she spoke it. People chose what was kept. On the site, anything AI drafted has a dashed underline.
